messages.subject: Re: winbugs removal problem
parts:
Hi, I think I have figured out the problem with my simulation code - I was using a binomial distribution to predict the count data, not a multinomial distribution.  In case it is helpful to anyone, here is the corrected code.

Jude


n.site <- 200
pct_ag <- sort(runif(n = n.site, min = -1.5, max =1.5))
other <- (runif(n = n.site, min = -1.5, max =1.5))


alpha.lam <- 0.1 # Intercept
beta1.lam <- 0.5 # Linear effect of vegetation
beta2.lam <- -0.3 # Quadratic effect of vegetation
lam <- exp(alpha.lam + beta1.lam * pct_ag + beta2.lam * other)

par(mfrow = c(2,1))
plot(pct_ag, lam, main = "", xlab = "", ylab = "Expected abundance", las = 1)

N <- rpois(n = n.site, lambda = lam) #select N at each site from poison distribution based on number of sites and lam
table(N) # Distribution of abundances across sites
sum(N > 0) / n.site # Empirical occupancy

plot(pct_ag, N, main = "", xlab = "pct ag", ylab = "Realized abundance")
points(pct_ag, lam, type = "l", lwd = 2)



alpha_p<-0.7 #intercept for detectability
beta_p<-(-0.9)#linear effect of ag

det.prob <- exp(alpha_p + beta_p * pct_ag) / (1 + exp(alpha_p + beta_p * pct_ag))
plot(pct_ag, det.prob, main = "", xlab = "", ylab = "Detection probability")

expected.count <- N * det.prob
plot(pct_ag, expected.count, main = "", xlab = "pct_ag", ylab = 
"Apparent abundance", ylim = c(0, max(N)), las = 1)
points(pct_ag, lam, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 2) # Truth


R <- n.site
T <- 5 # Number of replicate counts at each site
#y <- array(dim = c(R, T))


#for(j in 1:T){
#    y[,j] <- rbinom(n = n.site, size = N, prob = det.prob*(1-det.prob)^(j-1))#from Hierarchical modeling and inference in ecology p292
#}
#y

y<-array(dim = c(T,R))
for (t in 1:R){
y[,t]<-rmultinom(n=1, size=N[t], prob = c(  det.prob[t]*(1-det.prob[t])^(1-1), 
det.prob[t]*(1-det.prob[t])^(2-1), 
det.prob[t]*(1-det.prob[t])^(3-1), 
det.prob[t]*(1-det.prob[t])^(4-1), 
det.prob[t]*(1-det.prob[t])^(5-1)))
}
y<-t(y)
y


sum(apply(y, 1, sum) > 0) # Apparent distribution (proportion occupied sites)
sum(N > 0) # True occupancy

#C <- c(y)#arranges data so a vector with all sites rep1 first, then all sites rep 2 etc

ncap<-apply(y,1,sum)
nsites<-n.site
ymax<-apply(y,1,sum)
pct_ag2<-pct_ag*pct_ag

data <- list("y","nsites","ncap","pct_ag","other")#,,"other"
inits <- function(){
  list (N=ymax+2,p0=runif(1,-3,3))#,#psi0=psist,p0=runif(1),
#land = rnorm(nlandscapes,0,1), land.sd = runif(1,0,10) ,beta4=c(NA,0.1,-0.1))#,w2=1,w3=1,w4=1,w5=1, sigma.h= runif(1,0,10)
#, beta2=runif(1,-5,5)
}

cat("
model {

#priors
b0 ~ dnorm(0,0.001)
#bMean ~ dunif(0,1)
#b0 <- log(bMean) - log(1-bMean)
beta1~  dnorm(0,0.001)
beta2~  dnorm(0,0.001)

p0 ~ dnorm(0,0.01)
#aMean ~ dunif(0,1)
#p0 <- log(aMean) - log(1-aMean)
betap ~ dunif(-10,10)# 

#models
for(i in 1:nsites){
logit(p[i])<- p0 + betap*pct_ag[i]
#
mu[i,1]<- p[i]
mu[i,2]<- p[i]*(1-p[i])
mu[i,3]<- p[i]*(1-p[i])*(1-p[i])
mu[i,4]<- p[i]*(1-p[i])*(1-p[i])*(1-p[i])
mu[i,5]<- p[i]*(1-p[i])*(1-p[i])*(1-p[i])*(1-p[i])
pi0[i]<- 1 - mu[i,1]-mu[i,2]-mu[i,3]-mu[i,4]-mu[i,5] #1-prob cap in period 1 - prob cap in period 2..... = prob not captured
pcap[i]<-1-pi0[i] # 
for(j in 1:5){
muc[i,j]<-mu[i,j]/pcap[i]
}
y[i,1:5] ~ dmulti(muc[i,1:5],ncap[i])
ncap[i] ~ dbin(pcap[i],N[i])
N[i] ~ dpois(lambda[i])

log(lambda[i])<- b0 + beta1*pct_ag[i] +beta2*other[i]
#beta1=MFS_3km, beta2=PCT_AG_3km, beta3=SHDI_3km, beta4=hedge.vol.cat
#for random effect; looks up site_ordered for current location, then puts that into the distribution calc for land to get random effect.
}

#fit stuff from multinom code eg
for(i in 1:nsites){
 ncap.fit[i] ~ dbin(pcap[i],N[i])

 y.fit[i,1:5] ~ dmulti(muc[i,1:5],ncap[i])  # note this is conditional on ncap[i]
 for(t in 1:5){
   e1[i,t]<- muc[i,t]*ncap[i]
   resid1[i,t]<-     pow(pow(    y[i,t],0.5)-  pow(e1[i,t],0.5),2)
   resid1.fit[i,t]<- pow(pow(y.fit[i,t],0.5) - pow(e1[i,t],0.5),2)
   }
  e2[i]<- N[i]*lambda[i]
  resid2[i]<- pow(  pow(ncap[i],0.5) - pow(e2[i],0.5),2)
  resid2.fit[i]<- pow( pow(ncap.fit[i],0.5) - pow(e2[i],0.5),2)
}
ft1.data<- sum(resid1[,])
ft1.post<- sum(resid1.fit[,])

ft2.data<- sum(resid2[])
ft2.post<- sum(resid2.fit[])

}
",fill=TRUE,file="model.txt")



parameters <- c("p0","betap","b0","beta1","beta2","ft1.data","ft1.post","ft2.data","ft2.post")#"p1","p2","p3","N","beta0",,"w3","w4","beta2",
nthin<-1
nc<-3
nb<-1000
ni<-5000
library("R2WinBUGS")
out <- bugs (data, inits, parameters, "model.txt", n.thin=nthin,
             bugs.directory="C:\\Users\\JudeGirard\\WinBUGS14",
             n.chains=nc, n.burnin=nb,n.iter=ni,debug=TRUE)#,codaPkg=TRUE)

mean(out$sims.list$ft1.post>out$sims.list$ft1.data)
mean(out$sims.list$ft2.post>out$sims.list$ft2.data)
